question:

solution:
We compare the given figure with the options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b54bfd25c049eeb8a82b801a01788e4324885cc06d21c1faaca4a0e2f2515c32.png] The figure cannot be embedded.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d6eda9a562bb4f2e46152dc2d2b77b7808fb89072bd19dcae01eb1e2c19bc7d.png] The figure cannot be embedded.
